arxiv-2104-03240.title: Beam dynamics corrections to the Run-1 measurement of the muon anomalous magnetic moment at Fermilab
arxiv-2104-03240.creator: T. Albahri, A. Anastasi, K. Badgley, S. Baeßler, I. Bailey, V. A. Baranov, E. Barlas-Yucel, T. Barrett, F. Bedeschi, M. Berz, M. Bhattacharya, H. P. Binney, P. Bloom, J. Bono, E. Bottalico, T. Bowcock, G. Cantatore, R. M. Carey, B. C. K. Casey, D. Cauz, R. Chakraborty, S. P. Chang, A. Chapelain, S.
arxiv-2104-03240.description: Abstract This paper presents the beam dynamics systematic corrections and their uncertainties for the Run-1 dataset of the Fermilab Muon g − 2 g\!-\!2 Experiment. Two corrections to the measured muon precession frequency ω a m \omega_{a}^{m} are associated with well-known effects owing to the use of electrostatic quadrupole (ESQ) vertical focusing in the storage ring.

arxiv-2108-11715.title: Attractors of Caputo fractional differential equations with triangular vector fields
arxiv-2108-11715.creator: Thai Son Doan, and, Peter E. Kloeden
arxiv-2108-11715.description: Abstract It is shown that the attractor of an autonomous Caputo fractional differential equation of order α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \alpha\in(0,1) in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} whose vector field has a certain triangular structure and satisfies a smooth condition and dissipativity condition is essentially the same as that of the ordinary differential equation with the same vector field.

arxiv-2111-13658.title: Additive bases, coset covers, and non-vanishing linear maps
arxiv-2111-13658.creator: János Nagy, Péter Pál Pach, István Tomon
arxiv-2111-13658.description: Abstract Recently, the first two authors proved the Alon-Jaeger-Tarsi conjecture on non-vanishing linear maps, for large primes. We extend their ideas to address several other related conjectures. We prove the weak Additive Basis conjecture proposed by Szegedy, making a significant step towards the Additive Basis conjecture of Jaeger, Linial, Payan, and Tarsi.

arxiv-2205-01608.title: Local Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with Momentum-Based Variance Reduction
arxiv-2205-01608.creator: Junyi Li, Feihu Huang, Heng Huang
arxiv-2205-01608.description: Abstract Bilevel Optimization has witnessed notable progress recently with new emerging efficient algorithms and has been applied to many machine learning tasks such as data cleaning, few-shot learning, and neural architecture search. However, little attention has been paid to solve the bilevel problems under distributed setting.

arxiv-2208-08800.title: Localized growth drives spongy mesophyll morphogenesis
arxiv-2208-08800.creator: John D. Treado, Adam B. Roddy, Guillaume Théroux-Rancourt, Liyong Zhang, Chris Ambrose, Craig Brodersen, Mark D. Shattuck, Corey S. O’Hern
arxiv-2208-08800.description: Abstract The spongy mesophyll is a complex, porous tissue found in plant leaves that enables carbon capture and provides mechanical stability. Unlike many other biological tissues, which remain confluent throughout development, the spongy mesophyll must develop from an initially confluent tissue into a tortuous network of cells with a large proportion of intercellular airspace.

arxiv-2211-00068.title: Diffeomorphisms as quadratic charges in 4d BF theory and related TQFTs
arxiv-2211-00068.creator: Marc Geiller, Florian Girelli, Christophe Goeller, Panagiotis Tsimiklis
arxiv-2211-00068.description: Abstract We present a Sugawara-type construction for boundary charges in 4d BF theory and in a general family of related TQFTs. arxiv-2211-09474.description: Abstract We investigate exclusive electroproduction of π − ​ Δ + ⁣ + \pi^{-}\Delta^{++} within the handbag approach in which the helicity amplitudes factorize into generalized parton distributions (GPDs) and hard partonic subprocesses. We define the p − Δ p-\Delta transversity GPDs while the helicity non-flip GPDs are taken from the literature.

arxiv-2310-10472.title: Pointwise modulus of continuity of the Lyapunov exponent and integrated density of states for analytic multi-frequency quasiperiodic M ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) M(2,\mathbb{C}) cocycles
arxiv-2310-10472.creator: Matthew Powell
arxiv-2310-10472.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matthew Powell. It is known that the Lyapunov exponent for multifrequency analytic cocycles is weak-Hölder continuous in cocycle for certain Diophantine frequencies, and that this implies certain regularity of the integrated density of states in energy for Jacobi operators. In this paper, we establish the pointwise modulus of continuity in both cocycle and frequency and obtain analogous regularity of the integrated density of states in energy, potential, and frequency.

arxiv-2409-12075.title: The elastica sling
arxiv-2409-12075.creator: A. Cazzolli, F. Dal Corso
arxiv-2409-12075.description: Abstract The nonlinear mechanics of a flexible elastic rod constrained at its edges by a pair of sliding sleeves is analyzed. The planar equilibrium configurations of this variable-length elastica are found to have shape defined only by the inclination of the two constraints, while their distance is responsible only for scaling the size.

arxiv-2511-17078.title: Hash Collisions in Molecular Fingerprints: Effects on Property Prediction and Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2511-17078.creator: Walter Virany, Austin Tripp
arxiv-2511-17078.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Walter Virany, Austin Tripp. Molecular fingerprinting methods use hash functions to create fixed-length vector representations of molecules. However, hash collisions cause distinct substructures to be represented with the same feature, leading to overestimates in molecular similarity calculations. We investigate whether using exact fingerprints improves accuracy compared to standard compressed fingerprints in molecular property prediction and Bayesian optimization where the underlying predictive model is a Gaussian process.

pmc-11630859.creator: Yiyang Wu, Xiaotong Ding, Yiwei Wang, Defang Ouyang
pmc-11630859.description: Tissue engineering is a discipline based on cell biology and materials science with the primary goal of rebuilding and regenerating lost and damaged tissues and organs. Tissue engineering has developed rapidly in recent years, while scaffolds, growth factors, and stem cells have been successfully used for the reconstruction of various tissues and organs.

pmc-11655818.title: Production of [18F]DPA-714, [18F]fallypride and [18F]LBT-999 using iMiDEV, a fully automated microfluidic platform: towards clinical radiopharmaceutical production
pmc-11655818.creator: Salla Lahdenpohja, Camille Piatkowski, Laurent Tanguy, Bertrand Kuhnast
pmc-11655818.description: BackgroundPositron emission tomography is widely used to study biological processes without disrupting normal physiological functions. Traditional radiotracer synthesis and industrial market is focused on producing large batches of 18F-labelled tracers, especially [18F]FDG. Accessibility to smaller quantity of diverse radiopharmaceuticals is a key to enable a more personalised approach in nuclear medicine.

pmc-12417563.title: Different Diets in the Same Habitat: How Food Resource Distribution Shapes the Foraging Preferences of Shorebirds in Hangzhou Bay
pmc-12417563.creator: Dingda Chen, Yifei Jia, Kekan Yao, Shengwu Jiao, Lei Jing, Ming Wu
pmc-12417563.description: The Hangzhou Bay wetland is a crucial stopover site along the East Asian–Australasian Flyway. However, as wetland areas decrease and environmental changes occur, waterbirds have to adjust their dietary strategies to adapt to the available resources. In this study, the diet composition of 11 waders in Hangzhou Bay, China, was assessed via stable isotope analysis technology.

pmc-12427568.description: Simple SummaryTachypleus tridentatus is an economically important but endangered marine organism. This study aimed to elucidate the immune response mechanisms of T. tridentatus larvae to V.

pmc-12528427.title: Deep eutectic solvent assisted oil - water interfacial behavior on polystyrene surfaces: a computational study
pmc-12528427.creator: Kalampyr Bexeitova, Aida Ardakkyzy, Raushan Soltan, Galiya Baisalova, Damen Nurgalieva, Mirat Karibayev, Zhexenbek Toktarbay
pmc-12528427.description: Oil-water separation on hydrophobic polymer surfaces, such as polystyrene (PS), faces significant challenges due to poor interfacial control and low wettability. This study computationally explores the efficacy of Deep Eutectic Solvents (DES) as environmentally friendly additives to modify interfacial behavior and enhance compatibility between oil, water, and the polymer surface.

pmc-13026395.title: Comparative Study of Redox Status of MDCK Cells in Chicken Embryo Extract Versus Fetal Bovine Serum
pmc-13026395.creator: Jun-Hyun Kim, Jin-Mi Park, Mi-Kyung Nam, Seung-Min Hong, Eun-Ju Kim, Sun-Young Hwang, Kyoung-Ok No, Mee-Hyun Lee, Kang-Seuk Choi, Hyuk-Joon Kwon
pmc-13026395.description: Fetal bovine serum (FBS) is the standard supplement for cell culture, yet we previously demonstrated that it drives hyper-proliferation and phenotypic drift in Madin–Darby canine kidney (MDCK) cells, compromising their epithelial identity and ciliogenesis. In contrast, a modified chicken embryo extract (CEE) preserved these intrinsic properties, maintaining a stable and physiologically relevant phenotype.

pmc-13071719.title: Optimizing tryptophan supplementation for stress reduction and enhanced productivity in aging laying hens
pmc-13071719.creator: Abdolreza Hosseindoust, SeRin Park, Jun Young Mun, Sang Hun Ha, JinSoo Kim
pmc-13071719.description: This study explores the effects of dietary tryptophan (Trp) supplementation on stress mitigation and production parameters in aging laying hens housed under high-density conditions. A total of 700 Hy-line laying hens, aged 70 weeks, were used in the experiment. The hens were divided into four groups, receiving diets supplemented with 0%, 0.25%, 1%, and 2% Trp over a four-week period.

pmc-13405226.title: Differential responses to photoperiod in juveniles of two migratory songbird species
pmc-13405226.creator: Clara D'Autilia, Giuseppe Bianco, Susanne Åkesson
pmc-13405226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Songbirds rely on an endogenous programme encoding spatio-temporal information necessary for naive individuals to perform their first migration. Timing programmes are generated by endogenous clocks and include responses to external cues, with photoperiod being the most important. Photoperiod can advance or delay the circannual cycle and, while it is well established as a trigger for initiating migration, it remains uncertain whether birds continue to integrate photoperiod into their programme during migration.

pmc-13417931.creator: Elizabeth G. Rasmussen, Boris Wilthan
pmc-13417931.description: Knowing material behavior is crucial for successful design, especially given the growing number of next-generation energy, defense, and manufacturing systems operating in extreme environments. Specific applications for materials in extreme environments include fusion energy, semiconductor manufacturing, metal additive manufacturing, and aerospace. With increased applications, awareness of foundational science for materials in extreme environments is imperative.

pmc-13517914.description: The widespread circulation of the Anopheles vector is observed during the rainy season and clearly decreases during the dry season, when only a few mosquitoes are able to survive. This study aimed to identify the major species sustaining continued malaria transmission across seasons. This cross-sectional study was conducted in a malaria-endemic area.

pmc-13528390.title: Retrospective evaluation of a machine learning model to facilitate pharmacogenetic testing
pmc-13528390.creator: Adam Paul Yan, Santiago Eduardo Arciniegas, Iris Cohn, Ruud H J Verstegen, Winnie Seto, Shawna Silver, Lin Lawrence Guo, Jiro Inoue, Agata Wolochacz, Karim Jessa, George Tomlinson, Lillian Sung
